rules.title: Currency-grade hold
rules.condition: dollar spikes AND iron grade = B

review_notes: Define the dollar-spike threshold before automating purchases.

rules.title: Boil water mandate
rules.condition: river drinking water during the next 7 days

rules.title: Vector control — weekly drain
rules.action: clear stagnant water in coolers, planters, and open containers

rules.title: Fever escalation protocol
rules.action: visit nearest Primary Health Center immediately

review_notes: Demo advisory only. Issuer identity, affected area and effective date require review.

rules.title: Structural crack — immediate restriction
rules.condition: observed 4mm vertical crack on the northern load-bearing pillar

rules.title: Rebar exposure — corrosion risk
rules.condition: concrete spalling with exposed rebar observed
rules.action: record this structural defect in the inspection report

rules.title: Traffic diversion — safety measure
rules.condition: heavy trailers approaching the inspected bridge

review_notes: Inspector identity, GPS and inspection time require review. No repair deadline was dictated.

rules.title: Three-milestone payment
rules.action: pay 20% advance, 50% on dispatch, 30% within 15 days after inspection

rules.title: Shrinkage quality penalty
rules.action: apply 10% deduction; deduction basis requires agreement

rules.title: Delivery commitment
rules.action: deliver by 30 October; year not specified

review_notes: Confirm buyer/seller identities, GST treatment, delivery year and the basis for the 10% deduction.
